caption:
Stop rereading answer choices you already ruled out.

Use Bluebook's cross out tool: strike each choice the second you can prove it wrong. Then you only compare what's still standing.

Save this for your next practice test.
tiktok_caption: Stop rereading answer choices you already ruled out. Use the cross out tool.

youtube.title: SAT Tip: Use Bluebook's Cross Out Tool on Every Question
youtube.description: Cross out answer choices in Bluebook as soon as you can prove them wrong, so you only compare the ones left standing.
